the mechanisms that underlie the ability of the brain to process information and generate different types of activity patterns.

the authors demonstrate that S100β, a protein secreted by astrocytes, is essential for the ability of neurons to generate rhythmic bursting patterns.

astrocytes are not just passive supporters of neurons but they actively participate in neuronal activity by regulating the neuronal firing pattern.
